我的生活与家庭生活(My Life and family life): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:汤姆与安娜的经历和小计划。
Tom hopes to visit Paris one day. Last Saturday, Tom and Anna went to the living room. Tom is reading a book about science. Our neighbour looks after our cat when we travel.
Anna is interested in dancing. Both of them like fish and juice. Tom likes windy days best. Mum is frying eggs in the kitchen.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the living room by bike. Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Tom learned a lot about science. For example, I borrow books from the library every week.
The weather was windy that day. Tom spent the weekend at the zoo. The living room is one of the best places in the city.
